description.en: San Marino, officially the Republic of San Marino, is a landlocked country in Southern Europe, completely surrounded by Italy. Located on the northeastern slopes of the Apennine Mountains, it is the larger of two microstates within the Italian Peninsula, the other being Vatican City.
description.zh-CN: 聖馬力諾共和國，通稱聖馬力諾，其位于意大利半岛的亚平宁山脉东北侧，处于被意大利包围的国中国状态。圣马力诺国土面积61.2平方公里，人口33,344人。
description.zh-TW: 聖馬力諾共和國，通稱聖馬力諾，其位於意大利半島的亞平寧山脈東北側，處於被意大利包圍的國中國狀態。聖馬力諾國土面積61.2平方公里，人口33,344人。
